notes: Actual provider input tokens are summed across every recorded call. Unknown usage never becomes zero.
All attempted outcomes, wrong selections, errors and missing schedule slots are retained.
Latency is secondary and describes selection only; process startup, skill loading and task execution are excluded.
No uncertainty analysis was preregistered for this explicit-profile comparison; latency and token ratios are descriptive.
Earlier rejected general-profile candidates remain rejected. New next-skill labels do not replace old general outcomes.
Development executions are not counted twice when reports are refreshed. Diagnostic calls and offline parity are separate.
